name: Carmine
source:
Congratulations you've saved the world

Every world, every timeline is now safe thanks to you

You're going back home to your loving girlfriend.

So why...

Why aren't you happy?

[From [url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/carmine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
恭喜，你拯救了世界。

所有世界与所有时间线如今都因你而安全。

你将回到深爱你的女友身边。

那么，为什么……

你为什么不快乐？

[摘自[url=https://fouzi94.itch.io/carmine]Itch.io[/url]]
